info.title: Codebase intelligence for C#
info.description: Codebase intelligence for C# — dead code and duplicate detection.

commands.name: dead-code
commands.description: Find unused types, members, and files

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format [default: human] [possible values: human, json]

options.name: --aggressive
options.description: Also flag enum members and public settable auto-properties

options.name: --library
options.description: Project names to always treat in library mode (public API is used), regardless of executables elsewhere in the workspace

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to an explicit roe.json/roe.yaml/roe.yml config (skips auto-discovery)

options.name: --format
options.description:
Output format
[default: human]
[possible values: human, json]

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Matching mode
Possible values:
- exact:    Exact token match — only verbatim copy-pasted blocks match
- semantic: Identifiers and numeric literals are normalized to a shared placeholder, so renamed-but-structurally-identical blocks match too
[default: exact]

options.name: --no-code
options.description: Hide the duplicated source code printed under each group (human format only)

options.name: --min-tokens
options.description:
Minimum token-run length for a match to be reported
[default: 50]

options.name: --min-lines
options.description:
Minimum line span (of the shortest occurrence) for a match to be reported
[default: 5]

options.name: --min-occurrences
options.description:
Minimum number of occurrences for a match to be reported
[default: 2]

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to an explicit roe.json/roe.yaml/roe.yml config (skips auto-discovery)

commands.description: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
